title: Lime-Berry Chicken Salad
description: A delightful spinach salad with strawberries, snap peas and chicken is topped off with an outstanding homemade poppy seed dressing.
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into thin strips
1 cup sugar snap peas, ends and strings removed

steps.text: Toss chicken breasts, limeade, and pepper in a bowl. Cook the chicken breasts in a skillet until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 8 minutes. Remove skillet from the heat and set aside.
Combine sugar, vinegar, salt, mustard, and onion in a blender. Process for about 20 seconds. With the blender on high speed, gradually add oil in a slow and steady stream. Stir in poppy seeds.
Arrange spinach on 4 salad plates and top with strawberries, peas, pecans, and the cooked chicken. Serve with the poppy seed dressing.
